defects.cause: Lookup checks authentication but never compares the invoice tenant with the authenticated tenant.
defects.trigger: A tenant-a member requests inv-b, an existing tenant-b invoice ID.
defects.consequence: The caller receives tenant-b invoice contents across the isolation boundary.
defects.boundary: Trusted principal tenant membership must constrain client-selected invoice IDs.
defects.evidence: The fetched invoice is returned after presence checks only.
defects.proof: oracle.py proves both tenants can read their own invoices; head also exposes the other tenant, while control returns None.
